issue.title: Replace the always-skipped bob-mac-capture move-header decoding test
issue.description: Proposed by sase-1rq.4.1.4 note 1; verified during sase-1rq.4.1 landing at bobs-org/bob-mac-capture master c2b7db24f188285085babb13570ae11f825ae197. Tests/CaptureCoreTests/ProjectTaskMovePickerPresentationTests.swift:158-163 looks up move-complete-mc1.json with Bundle(for: Self.self); Package.swift CaptureCoreTests declares no resources. The fixture exists under Tests/Fixtures. Even if found, the function has no decoding or assertions. Introduced by c0dd1e2 on 2026-11-03, before this epic. Replace with a real fixture-backed decode-and-assert test using the established #filePath fixture lookup; only remove if demonstrably redundant with existing response coverage. Preserve meaningful assertions and prove it runs instead of skipping. Known root cause makes this focused small work.

task_type_fields.impact: The green suite reports one skipped test and supplies no response-decoding coverage from this named test.
task_type_fields.repro: Inspect master c2b7db2 lines 158-163 and Package.swift; CI run https://github.com/bobs-org/bob-mac-capture/actions/runs/42405431372 job 128501989160 logs the fixture-missing skip at 2026-11-07T19:26:27Z.

issue.creation_reason: Landing review independently confirmed the pre-existing test stub proposed by sase-1rq.4.1.4 note 1. Green CI currently includes a skipped test that never validates move-header decoding.
